details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3988-3991 and 4044-4048 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `_integration_branch_ahead_of_default` command substitutions in the finalize-integration path are unguarded under `set -e`, so a compare/API failure can abort before the fail-closed state-clearing logic runs.
  WHY: All six reviewers who called this out say the shell can exit at the assignment line before `_fimin_ahead_rc` is captured, leaving the stale merged pin uncleared; one reviewer cites the same safe pattern elsewhere in the script as a contrast.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9398-9405 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The check-wave-status `CWS_AHEAD_BY` command substitution is likewise unguarded, so a non-zero helper exit can abort before the else branch clears the variable.
  WHY: Moonshot and qwen report that a compare failure exits at the assignment instead of falling through to `CWS_AHEAD_BY=""`; deepseek’s separate note about a safe pattern elsewhere does not cover this site.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1664-1694 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The fallback summary heredoc is unquoted, so shell expansion applies to the body.
  WHY: Every reviewer says the current body works today, but future shell-looking text could expand silently and break the lockstep summary/grep contract; several explicitly frame this as a hardening risk rather than a current failure.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5044-5050 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The ORCH_INTEGRATION_BRANCH_PATTERN warning text is not stable enough for the contract/tests as written.
  WHY: x-ai says the emitted literal does not exactly match the contract-test expectation, while qwen says the empty and invalid-pattern cases share the same warning and are harder to distinguish in logs; deepseek and moonshot say the current wording is already correct, so this is disputed.
- review_autofix.yml, scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh, .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, probably_unnecessary_but_read_if_stuck.md:cross-file | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The refusal sentinel/notice/warning literals are duplicated across files and can drift out of lockstep.
  WHY: Both reviewers say changing one copy can disable the refusal-aware branch and its alert/cascade behavior; x-ai notes the new contract test now enforces the literals stay aligned.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:~1636 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The per-attempt temporary-file cleanup is duplicated across success, refusal, and loop-tail paths.
  WHY: x-ai says it is not a correctness bug today, but the duplication is maintainability-only and makes future edits error-prone.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3988 and 4044 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both assignments use bare command substitution of `_integration_branch_ahead_of_default` under the global `set -euo pipefail` set at line 12.
  WHY: When the GitHub compare API fails, `_integration_branch_ahead_of_default` returns 1, and the shell exits immediately at the assignment line before `_fimin_ahead_rc=$?` can capture the exit code.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1669 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The heredoc delimiter was changed from a quoted form (`<<'__EDITOR_SUMMARY__'`) to an unquoted form (`<<__EDITOR_SUMMARY__`) to allow `${_runtime_failure_path_line}` expansion.
  WHY: The current output works today, but the unquoted body is a future maintenance hazard because shell-looking tokens added later could expand into the emitted summary.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3988-3991 and 4044-4047 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: With `set -euo pipefail` active, a non-zero return from `_integration_branch_ahead_of_default` causes the shell to exit immediately at the assignment line before `$?` can be captured.
  WHY: The fail-closed handling never executes, leaving the pinned "merged" state uncleared even when the compare API fails.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1670 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The heredoc delimiter `<<__EDITOR_SUMMARY__` is unquoted, enabling shell expansion on the entire body.
  WHY: It works today, but any future `$()` or `${}` added to the body could silently expand and corrupt the lockstep contract text that grep patterns depend on.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3991-3993 and 4044-4067 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The command substitution pattern under `set -e` can cause the shell to exit immediately before the fail-closed branch runs.
  WHY: A non-zero exit from `_integration_branch_ahead_of_default` would abort the parent shell before the subsequent state-clearing logic, leaving the stale "merged" pin in place.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1664-1694 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The fallback summary heredoc delimiter is unquoted, so expansion is enabled throughout the entire heredoc body.
  WHY: The current body only intends one variable to expand, but future edits with `${...}` or `$(...)` text would be expanded at runtime and could corrupt the contract text.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3988-3991 and 4044-4048 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The command substitution pattern `_fimin_ahead_by="$(_integration_branch_ahead_of_default ...)"` is fragile under `set -euo pipefail`.
  WHY: If the helper returns non-zero, the shell exits at the assignment before the fail-closed handling can clear the pinned merged state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9399-9405 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The same `set -e` hazard exists in the check-wave-status ahead_by computation.
  WHY: A helper failure can abort the shell before the `else` block sets `CWS_AHEAD_BY=""`, so the fail-closed path is skipped.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1669-1693 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback summary heredoc uses an unquoted delimiter instead of `<<'__EDITOR_SUMMARY__'`.
  WHY: The current implementation only intends `_runtime_failure_path_line` to expand, but the unquoted delimiter means future shell-looking text in the body could expand and corrupt the contract output.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3988-3992 and 4044-4048 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The command-substitution assignment is not guarded by an `if`, so `set -e` can terminate the shell before the fail-closed block runs.
  WHY: If `_integration_branch_ahead_of_default` returns non-zero, Bash exits immediately at the assignment before `_fimin_ahead_rc=$?` or the subsequent state-clearing logic can run.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9398 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The same `set -e` command-substitution hazard exists in the `CWS_AHEAD_BY` assignment.
  WHY: A compare API failure would abort the poller tick at the assignment instead of letting the `else` branch set `CWS_AHEAD_BY=""`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~5044-5050 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The empty/invalid `ORCH_INTEGRATION_BRANCH_PATTERN` warning text is identical across two different failure modes.
  WHY: Auto-merge suppression still works, but the identical phrasing makes operator triage harder and creates a contract-string that must stay exact.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1664-1694 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback summary heredoc delimiter was changed from quoted to unquoted, enabling shell expansion throughout the entire body.
  WHY: Today only the intended line expands, but any future `${...}` or `$(...)` text would be expanded silently and break the grep-based lockstep contracts.
- review_autofix.yml, scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh, .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, probably_unnecessary_but_read_if_stuck.md:cross-file | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The refusal-aware sentinel/notice/warning literals are duplicated independently across files.
  WHY: If one copy drifts, `EDITOR_NOOP_REFUSAL` never fires and the refusal-specific alert/cascade behavior is lost; the new contract test is what enforces the lockstep now.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~3988 and ~4044 and _integration_branch_ahead_of_default (~2178-2210) | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Command substitution under `set -euo pipefail` aborts immediately on any non-zero exit from the helper.
  WHY: The subsequent `_fimin_ahead_rc=$?` line and fail-closed state-clearing logic are never reached, so a transient compare/API failure can leave `final_merge_status=merged` pinned.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~5044-5050 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The ORCH_INTEGRATION_BRANCH_PATTERN warning text does not exactly match the string asserted by the contract test.
  WHY: When the variable is empty or invalid, the emitted warning mismatches the expected literal and breaks operator greps and the test that verifies the guard honours the configured pattern.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:~1664 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback summary heredoc delimiter was changed from quoted to unquoted.
  WHY: Only one variable is meant to expand, but any future shell metacharacters in the static body would be evaluated and could corrupt the exact sentinel strings that downstream checks rely on.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:~1636 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The per-attempt temporary-file cleanup is duplicated after success, refusal, and the loop tail.
  WHY: This is not a correctness bug today, but it makes future edits error-prone and violates the desire to avoid duplicated cleanup logic.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh + review_autofix.yml + .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml + probably_unnecessary_but_read_if_stuck.md:cross-file | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The refusal sentinel, notice text, and warning text are duplicated independently across files with no shared constant.
  WHY: Any wording drift in one file can disable the refusal-aware branch, the specific Telegram alert, and the cache-bust short-circuit; the new contract test is what now catches that drift.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
